subject.pinned_by: content digests, not by name — the revision and manifest hashes fix the exact bytes measured

measurement.what_it_is: 7 of 30 on the governance bank. n=30 meets the estate's n>=30 floor, so the figure is quotable as an observation of THIS revision's behaviour on THIS bank.
measurement.what_it_never_proves: the model's quality, fitness, safety, or compliance. One axis, one bank, one revision, one fleet of one.

seal.note: The signature was re-verified here, not trusted from the seal's own `verification` field. A valid signature from a key that is not published in did.json proves the bytes were signed by SOMEONE; it does not make this an estate attestation. Internally-valid and trusted-signer are different properties and are never collapsed.
